source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, if this model is itself on the battlefield, then you can pick another **NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER** model of yours there, other than a **SKORPEKH LORD** or **EPIC HERO** model.

The picked model is **destroyed**, and no rules triggered by its destruction are resolved. This model takes its place with full wounds, and if the picked model led a unit, this model becomes that unit's [Leader](vsdata:core-ability/leader).

detail.condition: this model is on the battlefield

effect.ifTargetWasLeading: this model attaches to that unit as its Leader
